title: Sneijder 2010 or Çalhanoğlu 2024: Inter's best midfield season? THE DEBATE No. 9 #Shorts
description:
Sneijder 2010 or Çalhanoğlu 2024: Inter's best midfield season? Our pick: Hakan Çalhanoğlu, 2023–24.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?v=debate9 — the Italian Inter press in English every morning, free
THE DEBATE — a weekly fan-made argument, not the news.
Hakan Çalhanoğlu, 2023–24 (No. 20): 40 games, 15 goals in all competitions — 13 in Serie A (the most by an Inter midfielder in a league season since Lothar Matthäus's 16 in 1990–91), 10 of 10 penalties, 3 assists, 1,986 completed passes at 92%; Lega Serie A Best Midfielder 2023–24; Scudetto (the second star) and Supercoppa Italiana.
Wesley Sneijder, 2009–10 (No. 10): 41 games, 8 goals — 4 in Serie A, 3 in the Champions League, 1 in the Coppa Italia; 6 Serie A assists and 6 Champions League assists; the treble — Scudetto, Coppa Italia, Champions League; UEFA Club Midfielder of the Year 2010; 4th in the 2010 Ballon d'Or; FIFA FIFPro World XI 2010.
Sources: inter.it, uefa.com, legaseriea.it, Wikipedia
Fan-made — not affiliated with FC Internazionale Milano.
